arena.topic: Should AI systems be required to explain their decisions?
arena.context: Discussing AI transparency in high-stakes domains like healthcare, criminal justice, and lending.

personas.name: Silicon Valley Founder
personas.description: A tech startup founder who believes in moving fast and shipping products. Prioritizes innovation over regulation.
personas.background: Built multiple startups, believes market forces and user feedback are better regulators than government. Thinks explainability requirements will slow progress and benefit incumbents.

personas.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
personas.description: AI ethics researcher and professor who studies algorithmic accountability.
personas.background: Published extensively on algorithmic bias and the right to explanation. Believes transparency is essential for democratic oversight of automated systems.

personas.name: Former FDA Commissioner
personas.description: A regulatory pragmatist who has navigated the tension between innovation and safety.
personas.background: Oversaw approval processes for medical devices including AI-based diagnostics. Understands both the need for oversight and the costs of over-regulation.
